author: 130R
body:
I am planning to try to make Checkmate 2. This is my third attempt; so to ensure it becomes a good map I'm going to enlist you guys to help out. What should Checkmate 2:

  • Look like?
  • Gameplay style?
  • 'Floating islands' style - like the original - or something different?
  • Any other ideas you think will make it fun to play?

replies.author: Zedther
replies.body:
1: Bigger chess board + maybe even more chess boards
2: ^
3: floating islands with chests, maybe in the shape of things like rooks, bishops, etc.
4. A fun idea would be if it was just one huge chess board, with pieces like pawns on it as well, kind alike land marks.
